name: Okinoshima (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Okinoshima town emblem in blue and light blue: a blue and light blue swirl of waves around a white disc.
history: Municipal flag of Okinoshima, a town in Shimane Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 1 October 2005.
